name: Fractal Probability Concept (Hurst regime / value area / scaler)
description: DISPLAY-ONLY macro/regime context layer. A rolling DFA-Hurst exponent classifies the regime (persistent/neutral/mean-revert), a long-run value area locates price in its realized distribution, a Hurst target scaler implies tighter/wider targets vs the random-walk baseline, and a multifractal stress gauge flags turbulence. Never fires or vetoes a trade — it frames the confluence signals.

rules.role: Regime FILTER and macro context only — NEVER a trade trigger or veto.
rules.hurst_regime: DFA-Hurst H of recent log-returns. H >= 0.55 = PERSISTENT (trending, moves extend); H <= 0.45 = MEANREVERT (chop, moves fade); 0.45 < H < 0.55 = NEUTRAL (near random-walk).
rules.hurst_is_lagging: A rolling Hurst is backward-looking (effective lag ~= half the window). Never treat an H crossing as an entry — it confirms a regime that already began. Closed bars only.
rules.value_area: Long-run POC/VAH/VAL over ~500 closed bars (volume-less TPO approximation). Above VAH = extended high (reversion risk); below VAL = extended low; inside = fair/balanced.
rules.target_scaler: Under fBm, expected range over horizon tau scales as tau^H, not sqrt(tau). H < 0.5 -> tighten targets; H > 0.5 -> targets can run wider. COMPUTES the multiplier only; does not change live ATR sizing.
rules.multifractal_stress: Percentile of the current multifractal spectrum width (Δα) vs trailing windows. High = tape more turbulent than its own recent norm; treat projections with caution.
rules.thresholds_are_a_priori: Regime thresholds (0.45 / 0.55) are fixed a-priori and must NOT be fit to data.

regimeStats.note: Win-rate and profit-factor measured on 6,916 real safe 15m MES signals (2024-2026). Source: scripts/regime_layer/reports/REPORT.md.
